\begin{center}{\large\bfseries S13 Table. Reproduction of the published fits by the refits, and its effect on the counts.}\\[3pt]\emph{Osgood-Zimmerman \& Raredon}\end{center}
Of the 790 genes refitted with the published model specification, 778 reproduce the stored per-bin posterior medians and 95\% interval widths of the published fits within Monte Carlo error. A gene is flagged when, over 2,000 fixed bins, the median difference between the refit and published posterior medians exceeds 0.04 on the log scale, or the median ratio of 95\% interval widths (log scale) falls outside 0.9 to 1.1; differences between two independent sets of draws from one refit stayed within 0.02 and 0.96 to 1.04 for seven genes checked. The full per-gene check is in S14 File (\texttt{check2.csv}).

\textbf{(D) Plug-in reading from the refit.} For the 221 region comparisons of the flagged pairs, \textit{looks different} at $T = 1.25$ was recomputed from the refit's own posterior medians instead of the published fit: 214 of 221 calls agree; the number that look different but are not credible is 29 with the refit plug-in and 31 with the published one.
